column1: # F29-01 names eight things. This ledger maps every one to a measurement, the
# platform it ran on, and a captured artifact in this directory that holds the
# evidence. Clauses the EXISTING release pipeline already satisfies are marked
# PRE-EXISTING and NAMED rather than assumed -- pre-existing-controls.txt
# re-measures each of them directly against the tree rather than citing
#   MEASURED           - 29-02 ran something and captured the result
#   PRE-EXISTING       - the shipped pipeline already does this; 29-02 re-measured it, did not build it
#   NOT-PROVABLE-HERE  - needs a credential, a published release or hardware this lane does not have
# Supporting rows -- not F29-01 clauses in their own right, but the bindings and
# controls that make the eight above count as release integrity rather than as
